name: menu-tab-bar
title: Menu Tab Bar
description: An underline-style horizontal tab bar with icon support. Uses namespace exports: MenuTabBar.Root, MenuTabBar.Item, MenuTabBar.Icon, MenuTabBar.Composed.

docs.lead: An underline-style horizontal tab bar with optional leading icons and a smoothly animated underline indicator. Supports neutral and primary variants.
docs.usage: import * as MenuTabBar from "@/components/ui/menu-tab-bar" Overview Details

examples.title: Default
examples.description: Underline tab bar with icons matching the Figma design.

examples.title: Primary
examples.description: Primary variant with brand-colored underline and selected text.

examples.title: Composed
examples.description: Shorthand composed version with controlled value.
examples.code:
<MenuTabBar.Composed
  value={value}
  onValueChange={setValue}
  items={[
    { label: 'Home', value: 'home', icon: RiHome5Line },
    { label: 'Profile', value: 'profile', icon: RiUserLine },
  ]}
/>

examples.title: Scroll To Section
examples.description: Clicking a tab smooth-scrolls to the corresponding section by ID.

api.name: MenuTabBar.Root
api.description: Container for tab items with bottom border, tablist role, and animated underline indicator.

props.name: variant
props.description: Color scheme for the selected tab and underline indicator

props.name: scrollMargin
props.description: Gap in pixels left above the target section when scrolling to it. Works with any scroll container (page or nested overflow element).

api.name: MenuTabBar.Item
api.description: Individual tab button with underline indicator when selected.

props.name: selected
props.description: Whether this tab is currently selected

props.name: scrollTo
props.description: Element ID to smooth-scroll to when clicked

api.name: MenuTabBar.Icon
api.description: Polymorphic 16px icon inside a tab item.

props.name: as
props.description: The element or component to render as

api.name: MenuTabBar.Composed
api.description: Shorthand controlled tab bar. Accepts all Root props.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Callback when a tab is clicked

props.name: items
props.type: { label: string; value: string; disabled?: boolean; icon?: React.ElementType }[]
